_about: One entry per option shown on the phone for every photo, in this order. crop: true = auto-crop around the subject (subject fills ~1/3 of the frame); false = the whole photo. style: settings for explore.py (hydrant technique + route order). Main knobs: Lmin = shortest stroke kept (higher = fewer, longer lines); target = how much line in total; flow = smoothing (higher = rounder, looser; lower = closer to the edges); arc_max = how wide the joins swing; scene = 1 adds a few background lines; avoid = 1 sends joins around dense areas. Options on the same image share the slow AI step, so each extra one costs ~5-8 s. ids: short and unique. Depth options (depth=1, see depth.py): depth_keep / depth_flat = how much shorter lines on depth edges may be / how much longer lines on flat surfaces must be; depth_w = near-bolder strength; depth_flow = smoothing on outline lines (0 = none); depth_gap=1 adds outlines traced from the depth map where nothing covers them. Close-up options (q, r, s): depth_relief=1 adds soft 3D form (side of a nose); wobble drops scribbly strokes (turning above that many radians per 10 px; strokes longer than wobble_long x width always stay); merge joins strokes whose ends meet; quiet_joins draws joins as a hairline; fuse = band (fraction of the subject size) within which strokes running alongside each other melt into one line.
